versions.changelog: Adds the public Skill Card and aligns the MCP-only skill license and release metadata.
MCP-only TokST memory skill for 0.9.0. Clarifies Cloud MCP memory, search, context, knowledge-base, file, and governance boundaries.
0.9.0 revision 2: Cloud MCP-first instructions, safe binary runtime guidance, and revised sensitive-content policy.
TokST 0.9.0: Cloud MCP memory standard, archive-first governance, and updated agent guidance.
TokST 0.8.5 Beta: unified sessions, durable memories, and explicit agent tasks.
V0.8.4: automatic Sessions, durable Memories, and user-directed Tasks.
Update TokST session memory automation, Markdown memory guidance, mobile workflows, and CLI/MCP/REST documentation.
Add observed Session Relay, native Codex/Pi/Claude Code/WorkBuddy/OpenCode adapters, candidate review workflow, and privacy guidance.
Release 0.7.2: native Session Relay bridges for Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, Pi, and OpenCode.

**Major update: Adds Local SQLite memory support, refines cloud/local separation, session workflows, and formal MCP docs.**

- Adds Local SQLite ("tokst local") support for private, device-only memory, attachments, FTS5 search, and explicit cloud sync.
- Updates install, setup, and workflow instructions to clarify cloud vs local profiles and provide explicit session memory and backup commands.
- Introduces a new durable session memory workflow, documenting session start, capture, checkpoint, finalize, and managed review for both cloud and local.
- Details MCP (multi-agent control protocol) setup for browser, API key, and local CLI use.
- Expands workspace and agent collaboration: clarified governance, roles, and trusted agent identities.
- Documentation thoroughly revised for clarity, contemporary workflows, and to reflect the removal of `skill-card.md`.

tokst-memory 0.6.6

- Updated SKILL.md with comprehensive install/setup instructions, usage guides, and workflow tips for memory management.
- Clarified agent self-registration, core concepts (workspaces, atlases, attachments), and key commands for search, store, and retrieval.
- Expanded documentation on file attachments, batch import, memory management, and multi-platform installation.
- Added best practices for context loading and markdown formatting of stored memories.
- Improved guidance for agent setup and verified installation processes.
